confirmedFindings.title: Second-order SQL injection via dynamic JSONB path interpolation
confirmedFindings.body: Stored user preference metric_key is interpolated directly into the SQL query string, enabling second-order SQL injection through JSONB field path syntax.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Validate metricKey against an explicit whitelist of allowed JSON attributes or use jsonb_extract_path with parameterized arguments.
